question: Who are the lords of the hundred Rudras beyond the Brahma egg?
premises: The hundred Rudras have their own lords.
Those lords are eleven Rudras of great radiance.
The verse begins naming them as Ananta, Kapalin, Agni, Yama, Nairrita, and Bala.
inference: Therefore the hundred Rudras are ruled by eleven radiant Rudra-lords beginning with Ananta.
uncertainties: The full list of eleven names continues into verse 181.
plain_english: The hundred Rudras beyond the Brahma egg have eleven radiant Rudra-lords of their own, beginning with Ananta, Kapalin, Agni, Yama, Nairrita, and Bala.
